items.title: Consideration of applications (43 applications) of already registered stains of Bio-pesticides u/s 9(3) of the Insecticide Act, 1968.
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and approved the cases of (43 applications) of already registered stains of Bio-pesticides u/s 9(3) of the Insecticide Act, 1968 to the applicants as per the list attached at Annexure-6.1.1.

items.title: Consideration of an application of M/s Agrow Allied Ventures Private Ltd., for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Fluroxypyr- meptyl 45.5 % EC under section 9(3) FIM (FIM vs FI) of the Insecticide Act, 1968.
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and approved for grant of registration indigenous manufacture of Fluroxypyr-meptyl 45.5 % EC for control of weeds Amaranthus viridis, Anagalis arvensis, Chenopodium album, Euphorbia spp., Parthenium hysterophorus, Physalis minima, Trianthema spp on Onion crop, with a shelf life of two years.

items.title: Consideration of an application of M/s BASF INDIA LIMITED for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Pyraclostrobin 75 g/L + Tricyclazole 150 g/L ZC under section 9(3) FIM (FIM vs FI) of the Insecticide Act, 1968.
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and approved for grant of registration for Indigenous manufacture of Pyraclostrobin 75 g/L + Tricyclazole 150 g/L ZC for the control of blast disease of Rice u/s 9(3) FIM (FIM vs FI) of Insecticide Act, 1968. With a shelf life of two years.

items.title: Consideration of an application of M/s Seedlings India Private Limited for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Fluxapyroxad 333g/l FS under section 9(3) FIM (FIM vs FI) of the Insecticide Act, 1968.
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and approved for grant of registration for Indigenous manufacture of Fluxapyroxad 333g/l FS for the control of Anthracnose on Sorghum, Rhizoctonia root rot & Cotyledonary spot on Soybean, Seedling disease of cotton, Aspergillus black rot of Groundnut and Black Scurf of Potato u/s 9(3) FIM (FIM vs FI) of Insecticide Act, 1968. With a shelf life of two years.

items.title: Consideration of an application of M/s Ichiban Crop Science Limited for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Fluxapyroxad 75g/l + Difenoconazole 50 g/l SC under section 9(3) FIM (FIM vs FI) of the Insecticide Act, 1968.
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and approved for grant of registration for Indigenous manufacture of Fluxapyroxad 75g/l + Difenoconazole 50 g/l SC for the control of Powdery mildew of Grapes and Scab & Powdery mildew of Apple u/s 9(3) FIM (FIM vs FI) of Insecticide Act, 1968. With a shelf life of two years.

items.title: Consideration of an application of M/s Seedlings India Private Limited for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Fluxametamide 10% w/w EC under section 9(3) FIM (FIM vs FI) of the Insecticide Act, 1968.
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and approved for grant of registration indigenous manufacture of Fluxametamide 10% w/w EC for the control of leaf hoper, thrips, fruit and shoot borer on brinjal; diamond back mark, tobacco caterpillar, semilooper on cabbage ; Thrips, Fruit Borer, Tobacco Caterpillar on Chilli; Leaf hopper, thrips, Fruit borer on okra; spotted pod borer, pod Borer on red gram; Thrips, Fruit borer on Tomato u/s 9(3) FIM (FIM vs FI) of Insecticide Act, 1968 with a shelf life of two years.

items.title: Consideration of an application of M/s Deccan Fine Chemicals (India) Private Limited for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Isopyrazam Technical 92.00% w/w Min. under section 9(3) TIM vs TI of the Insecticide Act, 1968.
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and approved for grant of registration for Technical Indigenous manufacture of Isopyrazam Technical 92.00% w/w Min. under section 9(3) TIM (TIM vs TI) with a shelf life of two years.

items.title: Consideration of an application of M/s SML Limited for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Sulphur 60% + Spiromesifen 3.8% WDG under section 9(3) FIM of the Insecticide Act, 1968.
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and approved for grant of registration for Indigenous manufacture of Sulphur 60% + Spiromesifen 3.8% WDG for the control of Powdery mildew (Erysiphe cichoracearum) on Okra, Leaf Spot (Cercospora melongenae) on Brinjal & Powdery mildew (Podosphaera pannosa) on Rose, red spider mite (Tetranychus urticae) on Okra, brinjal and rose crop only u/s 9(3) FIM of Insecticide Act,1968. Subject to the fixation of MRL with a provisional shelf life of two years. The following conditions may also be incorporated in the CR or L/L wherever applicable: i. A cautionary statement shall be incorporated on the label and leaflet stating: “The product is very toxic to fish, aquatic organisms and honeybees; do not contaminate water bodies and avoid application during active bee foraging periods.” ii. A condition that applicant is required to submit real time / actual storage stability study data in the proposed construct and container of sale for duration of minimum 30 months, within two and half years of submission of application for granting the registration, failing which Registration Certificate shall be deemed cancelled.

items.title: Consideration of an application of M/s Willowood Chemicals Ltd. for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Flonicamid 4%+ Chlorantraniliprole 4% + Pymetrozine 12% SC under section 9(3) FIM of the Insecticide Act, 1968.
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and approved the grant of registration for indigenous manufacturing of Flonicamid 4%+ Chlorantraniliprole 4% + Pymetrozine 12% SC under section 9(3) of Insecticide Act, 1968 for the control of Brown plant hopper (Nilaparvata lugens), White backed plant hopper (Sogatella furcifera), Green leaf hopper (Nepotettix virescens), Leaf folder (Cnaphalocrocis medinalis) and Stem Borer (Scirpophaga incertulas) on rice crop only; subject to the fixation of MRL with a provisional shelf life of two years. The following conditions may also be incorporated in the CR or L/L wherever applicable: i. A cautionary statement shall be incorporated on the label and leaflet stating: “The product is very toxic to fish, aquatic organisms and honeybees; do not contaminate water bodies and avoid application during active bee foraging periods.” ii. A condition that applicant is required to submit real time / actual storage stability study data in the proposed construct and container of sale for duration of minimum 30 months, within two and half years of submission of application for granting the registration, failing which Registration Certificate shall be deemed cancelled.

items.title: Consideration of application for 9(4) FIM u/s 9(4).
items.decision: RC deliberated the agenda and decided as per Annexure –8.1.1 In case of satisfactory cases, CRs shall be issued only after KYC compliance of the applicant account and submission of the original affidavit, as per the format provided in 439th RC, by the applicant, duly forwarded by the authorized signatory only, within 15 days from the uploading of the minutes. In case the original affidavit is already submitted, then the applicant is required to email the copy of the acknowledgement, within 15 days from the uploading of the minutes to reconcile, afterwards, no such request shall be entertained to issue the CR. It was also directed to strictly follow Gazette Notification SO 3951 (E) dated 08.08.2018 published on 09.08.2018 by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, while issuing approvals.

items.title: Consideration and compliance of order dated 10.08.2026 passed by the Hon'ble Revisional Authority in Revision Petition No. 02 of 2026 filed by M/s Godrej Agrovet Ltd. Vs. CIB&RC and M/s Best Crop Science Pvt. Ltd.
items.decision: RC perused the Order dated 10.08.2026 passed by the Hon'ble Revisional Authority wherein the matter has been remanded by the Hon'ble Revisional Authority for a limited review of the issues relating to the manufacturing process, impurity profile, chemical equivalence and the consequential safety implications arising therefrom. RC also perused the letter dated 13.08.2026 from M/s Godrej Agrovet ltd. The Committee was apprised that, in compliance with the directions of the Hon'ble Revisional Authority, the complete chemistry dossier and all documents available on record were re-examined. The Committee noted that the applicant had submitted the requisite documents prescribed under the extant TIM vs. TI Guidelines, including the list of raw materials and intermediates with source of supply, stepwise manufacturing process, chemical equations, flow sheet diagram from raw materials to the final technical product, effluent treatment method, specifications, method of analysis, impurity profile and supporting analytical data. The Committee further noted that chemical equivalence had already been established with the registered source, M/s Godrej Agrovet Limited, and that the chemical composition, specifications and impurity limits submitted by the applicant were identical to those of the registered source. The Committee also noted that an in-process sample drawn during inspection by officers of the Directorate had been tested by the Central Insecticides Laboratory (CIL) and found to conform to the submitted specifications. The CIL analysis did not reveal any unidentified impurity or any additional impurity having any toxicological concern. The reported impurity profile was within the prescribed limits and no toxicologically significant impurity arising from the disclosed manufacturing process was detected. The Committee further deliberated upon the concerns raised before the Hon'ble Revisional Authority regarding the manufacturing process and the possible formation of toxicologically significant impurities. After examining the chemistry dossier, impurity profile, CIL analytical report and other material available on record, the Committee observed that no chemistry- related deficiency or safety concern has been established. The available data do not indicate the formation or presence of any additional toxicologically significant impurity under the disclosed manufacturing process. The RC also noted that the petitioner's contention regarding the use of chloroform during the manufacturing process, including the alleged possibility of the formation of Methoxy Isocyanide and it’s derivatives or any other additional impurities arising therefrom, is not revealed from the technical dossier or the reports available on record. The Committee observed that no such concerns are reflected in the technical documentation or analytical reports submitted by the applicant or generated by the Central Insecticides Laboratory. Accordingly, the RC found no merit or substance in the averments made by the petitioner in this regard. Accordingly, the Registration Committee, after thorough re-examination of the matter in compliance with the Order dated 10.08.2026 of the Hon'ble Revisional Authority and considering the available material on records, found no reason to interfere with its earlier decision taken in the 471st RC Meeting under Agenda Item No. 6.59, to grant registration for the indigenous manufacture of Fluxametamide Technical 93.5% Min. under Section 9(3) of the Insecticides Act, 1968, in the TIM vs. TI category, to M/s Best Crop Science Pvt. Ltd. The Committee, therefore, decided to uphold its earlier decision for grant of registration for Technical Indigenous manufacture of Fluxametamide Technical 93.50 % w/w Min. under section 9(3) TIM vs TI, with a provisional shelf life of two years. The applicant has to submit the real time shelf-life data as per existing guideline of RC within two and half years of submission of application for granting the registration, failing which Registration Certificate shall be deemed cancelled. A condition shall be incorporated in the CR of the applicant. It was further decided that the formulation files containing Fluxametamide in solo or combination pending as on date shall be put up to RC in next meeting of RC. RC directs the Secretary, CIB&RC to communicate this decision to the Hon’ble Revisional Authority and the respective parties.

items.title: Consideration of the representation of M/s Crystal Crop Protection Ltd. regarding the requirement of mutagenicity data for grant of registration for indigenous manufacture of Bensulfuron Methyl Technical 97% w/w min. under Section 9(3) TIM (TIM vs. TI) of the Insecticides Act, 1968.
items.decision: The Committee considered the representation of M/s Crystal Crop Protection Ltd. seeking waiver of the mutagenicity data requirement, with reference to the decision of the 473rd RC Meeting vide Agenda Item No. 6.7. The applicant submitted that the studies were initiated on 23.12.2019 and completed on 22.06.2022 under the data requirements prevailing at that time and claimed that mutagenicity data were not required where chemical equivalence with the earlier Section 9(3) registered technical was established. The applicant further submitted that the data requirements were subsequently revised pursuant to the 442nd RC Meeting held on 18.11.2022, i.e. after completion of the studies. The applicant also relied upon the decision of the 424th RC Meeting vide Agenda Item No. 10.26, contending that the RC had considered mutagenicity data as not required where chemical equivalence had been established. The Committee, after deliberation, observed that the present application was submitted on 21.02.2023, subsequent to the 442nd RC Meeting dated 18.11.2022, wherein the applicable toxicological data requirements included submission of mutagenicity data. The Committee further observed that the decision of the 424th RC Meeting pertained to Section 9(4) TIM applications and were not applicable to the present Section 9(3) TIM application. Further, evidence establishing chemical equivalence with the earlier Section 9(3) registered technical has not been furnished. The Committee, after deliberation, observed that, as per the “Guidance Document on Toxicology for Registration of Chemical Pesticides”, adopted in the 377th RC meeting, read with the relevant data requirements approved in the 381st, 440th, 442nd and 449th RC meetings, the prescribed mutagenicity data are mandatory requirement for toxicological evaluation and characterization of the genotoxic potential of the technical grade active ingredient. In the absence of such data, the genotoxic hazard profile cannot be adequately characterized for a scientifically sound safety assessment. Accordingly, the Committee did not find sufficient justification for waiver of the prescribed mutagenicity data and decided that the applicant shall submit the complete mutagenicity data package as per the applicable guidelines for further scientific evaluation and consideration of the application.

items.title: Follow up action on the decision of The RC taken in its 470th meeting at agenda item no. 10.12 with respect to the writ petition no. 29263/2024 at Hon’ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh pertaining to N-Nitroso Pendimethalin. The RC was apprised that the above matter could not be taken up for hearing since previous few dates and the matter is now listed for hearing on 24.09.2026. Looking to the importance and sensitivity of the matter
items.decision: RC decided that a D.O. Letter may be written by the Charmain RC to the Learned Additional Solicitor General of India (ASGI) Hon’ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh to kindly appear in the above matter and effectively place the submission of the Union of India/RC as the matter relates to the larger public health issue.

items.title: Inadvertent Mention of Hydrogen Cyanamide 50% 487485-F/9(4)2026 M/s Elanta Agro Pvt.Ltd. Hydrogen Cyanamide 50% SL (9(4) FIM S.No. 223) in the 473rd Registration Committee It was informed to the RC that Hydrogen Cyanamide 50% SL (9(4) FIM, S. No. 223) in the minutes of the 473rd Registration Committee (RC) appears to have been included inadvertently in FIM category. As per the decision of the 399th RC, Agenda Item No. 9.21, the said formulation is required to be considered under the category of Technical. In view of the above, the inadvertent mention of Hydrogen Cyanamide 50% SL 9(4) FIM, S. No. 223 in the minutes of the 473rd RC may not be construed as approval of the said formulation. Accordingly,
items.decision: RC decided that Hydrogen Cyanamide 50% SL (9(4) FIM, S. No. 223 may not be considered as approved on the basis of its inadvertent mention in the minutes of the 473rd RC, hence the application is rejected.
